appraisal_events.evidence: aucune demande d'inviter personne, aucune parole, même pas un détournement de regards... il m'était impossible de lui faire des reproches ou de lui poser des questions... contradiction... qui me faisait souffrir toute la nuit, dont je n'osais plus reparler
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator recounts becoming unable to question or reproach Albertine, reduced to reading silences and averted glances that leave him suffering through sleepless nights while she gives nothing away.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator is left powerless and suffering, unable to challenge Albertine directly, showing him without emotional leverage in the relationship.

By withholding any word or request and replacing her earlier open glances at passing girls with silence, Albertine controls what the narrator can know or challenge, giving her the emotional upper hand.
